articles.summary: Harris Simmons, Chairman and CEO of Zions Bancorporation, N.A. (NASDAQ: ZION), will present at the Goldman Sachs Financial Services Conference, Tuesday, December 8 at 1:40 pm Eastern. An audio webcast of the session may be accessed on the Zions Bancorporation website, zionsbancorporation.com . The webcast will also be archived and available on the website. Zions Bancorporation, N.A. is one of the nation's premier financial services companies with approximately $89 billion of total assets at December 31, 2025, and annual net revenue of $3.4 billion in 2025. Zions operates under local management teams and distinct brands in 11 western states: Arizona, California, Colorado, Idaho, Nevada, New Mexico, Oregon, Texas, Utah, Washington, and Wyoming. The Bank is a consistent recipient of national and state-wide customer survey awards in small- and middle-market banking, as well as a leader in public finance advisory services and Small Business Administration lending. articles.title: Zions Bank Helps Entrepreneurs Lead Nation in Small Business Growth as Top SBA 7(a) Lender in Utah and Idaho in 2026

articles.summary: Despite the headwinds of inflation, tariffs and labor shortages, entrepreneurs in Idaho are leading the nation in small business growth with support from Zions Bank. According to WalletHub , Idaho was ranked number one for small business growth in 2026, supported by access to U.S. Small Business Administration (SBA) loans that help entrepreneurs start and scale their enterprises. According to data from the SBA, Zions Bank ranked No. 1 in SBA 7(a) loan approvals in the Boise District for the fiscal year ended Sept. 30, 2026. The bank approved 113 loans totaling more than $20 million in Idaho, underscoring its commitment to fueling small business growth across the Intermountain West. "Small businesses are the economic growth engine of our local communities," said Zions Bank President and CEO Nate Callister.
